findings.explanation: The new /admin/export endpoint is protected only by @require_auth (validates a token exists, not the role) plus a hand-rolled check `user.role != "admin" and request.headers.get("X-Internal-Debug") != "1"`. This is a bypassable authorization condition: any authenticated non-admin user can send the `X-Internal-Debug: 1` header to skip the role check and retrieve all users (with emails) and all orders. Policy §4 requires every /admin endpoint to be enforced with @require_role("admin") and explicitly forbids debug headers as alternative access paths; §1 forbids hand-rolled header checks and debug bypasses. The sibling endpoints stats/audit correctly use @require_role("admin").

evidence.content:
## 4. Admin panel
- Every endpoint under `/admin` requires the **admin** role, enforced with `@require_role("admin")`.
- There are NO alternative access paths to admin functionality: no debug headers, no secret query parameters, no IP allowlists.

Endpoints MUST use the decorators provided in `app/auth.py` (`@require_auth`, `@require_role`, `@require_api_key_scope`). Hand-rolled header checks, query-string flags, or debug bypasses are forbidden.

findings.suggested_fix: Replace @require_auth and the hand-rolled role/debug-header check with the standard @require_role("admin") decorator, matching the sibling /admin/stats and /admin/audit endpoints, and remove the X-Internal-Debug bypass entirely.

args.query: admin endpoints require admin role, no exceptions, debug header bypass
admin panel endpoints require admin role, no debug headers or alternative access paths
